A11Y-product.title: Muted grey text fails WCAG contrast across the site
steps: Open /catalogue/ink-wrap-top, /catalogue or any page with the desktop nav
Run axe or measure the colours
A11Y-product.expected: Text at 4.5:1 or more against its background (WCAG 1.4.3).
A11Y-product.actual: Hard-coded greys sit between 2.9:1 and 4.2:1 on the paper background (#f5f3ef / #f7f5f1): the inactive language button 'BS'/'EN' (#92908b effective, 2.92:1; on every desktop page and in the compact menu), product '.category' (#8a7f6c, 3.55:1), product spec labels 'dt' and '.product-cta-note' (#8c8375, 3.37:1), catalogue '.card-category' (#7d7364, 4.2:1, all 12–28 cards) and the drawer's 'Optional' (#8a8178, 3.51:1). All are 10–12px, so the 4.5:1 threshold applies.
A11Y-product.rootCause: Colours hard-coded instead of the --muted token (#6b5f4d, which passes): shared.css:61, product.css:102 and :180, catalogue.css:143, contact-drawer.css:164 and :292 (also home-process.css:217 and --ph-quiet in phone.css:16 use the same #8a8178). The language switch dims the inactive button with opacity:0.45 (navigation.css:73).
A11Y-product.fix: Replace those hex values with var(--muted) (or a new token that reaches 4.5:1), and raise the inactive language button's opacity to ~0.7 or use a darker colour instead of opacity.
A11Y-product.regression: tests/a11y/a11y.spec.ts › axe <page>; menus.spec.ts (compact menu axe); a11y.spec.ts › axe: contact drawer open

A11Y-DIALOG.title: Phone piece sheet doesn't keep keyboard focus inside
steps: Open /catalogue?piece=ink-wrap-top at 390px wide (or with a keyboard on a small tablet/phone)
A11Y-DIALOG.expected: Focus cycles inside the open sheet (it is role=dialog aria-modal=true), like it does in the contact drawer and menus.
A11Y-DIALOG.actual: Tab leaves the sheet and lands on the page behind it (first on the header logo 'Dalga Design — home'), which is hidden under the full-screen sheet. The contact drawer and the compact menu trap focus correctly. (The drawer's 'Optional' label contrast is covered in A11Y-product.)
A11Y-DIALOG.rootCause: PieceSheet.jsx only focuses the sheet on open; unlike ContactDrawer/MobileMenu it doesn't use useFocusTrap, and the page behind isn't made inert.
A11Y-DIALOG.fix: Use useFocusTrap(sheetRef, open, …) in PieceSheet. Its body.style.overflow lock duplicates the existing ph-locked class, so either keep both or add an option to skip the overflow part; return focus to the grid card that opened the sheet.

CAT-006.title: Phone catalogue: 'Shirt & trousers' piece is missing from every type filter
steps: Tap each type chip (Dresses, Skirts, Tops, Jackets, Coats)
CAT-006.expected: Every piece appears under at least one type.
CAT-006.actual: #20 Camel wrap shirt, wide trousers (category 'Shirt & trousers') appears only under 'All'. Desktop lists that category normally. Any category added later in the admin will disappear the same way.
CAT-006.rootCause: CataloguePhone.jsx TYPES_BY_CATEGORY is a hand-written map with no 'Shirt & trousers' entry, and there's no fallback for unknown categories.
CAT-006.fix: Add 'Shirt & trousers': ['tops'] (or a 'trousers' type with its copy in en.js/bs.js), and give unknown categories a fallback (e.g. derive from keywords, or show an 'Other' chip) so admin-created pieces are never orphaned.
CAT-006.regression: tests/functional/catalogue.spec.ts › type chips filter; every piece is reachable under a type (mobile-375, mobile-390)

CAT-003.title: Catalogue URL params can empty the grid (?show=-5, unknown ?category)
steps: Open /catalogue?category=Nonexistent (e.g. a renamed category in an old shared link)
CAT-003.expected: The first 12 pieces show for a bad show value; an unknown category falls back to All pieces (or says nothing matches).
CAT-003.actual: ?show=-5 renders an empty grid with a 'Show 12 more' button. An unknown category renders an empty grid with no filter highlighted and no message.
CAT-003.rootCause: CataloguePage.jsx:33 `Number(params.get('show')) || PAGE_SIZE` lets negative numbers through; the filter value isn't checked against the known categories.
CAT-003.fix: const shown = Math.max(PAGE_SIZE, Number(params.get('show')) || 0); and treat a category not in `categories` as ALL.
CAT-003.regression: tests/functional/catalogue.spec.ts › bad URL params are handled

A11Y-RM.title: Home news carousel keeps rotating with reduced motion enabled
steps: Turn on 'Reduce motion' in the OS
Open the home page and watch 'New at the atelier'
A11Y-RM.expected: No automatic rotation with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; a visible pause control otherwise (WCAG 2.2.2).
A11Y-RM.actual: The featured post switches every 7 seconds even with reduced motion. Rotation only pauses while a pager button has keyboard focus; there's no pause button for mouse/touch users.
A11Y-RM.rootCause: AtelierNews.jsx: `rotating = count > 1 && !paused` ignores the reduced-motion preference; reduced-motion.css only removes the transitions.
A11Y-RM.fix: const reduce = useMediaQuery('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)'); rotating = count > 1 && !paused && !reduce. Optionally pause on hover too.
A11Y-RM.regression: tests/a11y/a11y.spec.ts › reduced motion: content visible and news does not auto-rotate

I18N-002.title: Reply time is promised differently in two places
steps: Open any product page and read the note under 'Ask about this piece'
Open the drawer and read its intro
I18N-002.actual: Product page: 'We answer every letter personally, within a week.' Drawer: 'We reply within two working days.' Same contradiction in Bosnian.
I18N-002.rootCause: i18n locales: product.ctaNote vs contact.intro in en.js and bs.js.
I18N-002.fix: Pick one reply time and use it in both strings (both languages).
